summary: Project focused on optimizing the mobile user experience, prioritizing speed and usability.
architectural_notes: Mobile-first performance and usability are top priorities (optimize assets, layout, navigation, and interactions for small screens).

existing_features.title: Increase mobile touch target sizes across interactive controls (buttons, clickable cards, links) to be tap-friendly, ensuring primary actions on tool pages (e.g., upload area, primary CTA buttons, secondary/reset buttons) are comfortable to use on small screens.

Add a sticky bottom navigation on mobile that provides quick access to tool categories (e.g., PDF Tools, Image Tools, Calculators, Utility Tools). The bottom nav must be visible only on small screens, must not cover important CTAs, and must include an accessible interaction model (focus states, labels).

Optimize mobile performance for images and icons by reducing unnecessary work during initial render and ensuring media loads efficiently (e.g., lazy-loading non-critical images, minimizing heavy visual effects on mobile, and respecting prefers-reduced-motion).

Ensure a clean one-column layout on small screens for key content sections (home tool surfaces and tool pages), preventing multi-column grids from feeling cramped and ensuring readable spacing/typography on mobile.

Add smooth swipe-friendly interactions/animations on mobile for browsing tool/category content (e.g., horizontal swipeable rows or carousels with scroll-snap), while keeping motion subtle and performant.

new_feature_requests.summary: Improve mobile UX with larger tap-friendly buttons
Add sticky bottom navigation for tool categories on mobile
Optimize mobile performance by faster-loading images and icons
Implement one-column clean layout for small screens
Add smooth swipe animations for mobile interactions

projectName: Optimize mobile UX: tap targets, sticky bottom category nav, faster visuals, one-column layout, and swipe interactions
